name: 1mail-prototype
description: iPhone-first 1Mail prototype with native test wrapper.

scripts.ios:add: npm run build && npx cap add ios && npm run ios:configure-oauth
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npm run ios:configure-oauth
scripts.ios:open: npm run ios:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.ios:run: npm run ios:sync && npx cap run ios
